sources.snippet: Description NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4 is the quantized release of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a vision-language model for reasoning, coding, tool use, document understanding, and video understanding. It uses NVFP4 quantization to reduce memory requirements, with quantization-aware distillation from the BF16 model.
